description: Valence Macroeconomic Golden Benchmark Dataset across US, India, UK, and Japan markets with consensus labels and OKF rule alignments.

samples.okf_rule: US Macro Rule 1 (Fed Policy Pivot)

samples.okf_rule: US Macro Rule 2 (Above-Expectations CPI Print)
